0197 Great Hero Chen Stood on the Edge of the Podium Like a Lackey (Page 1/2)

The Chinese online game market at the end of 2005 was highly competitive.

World of Warcraft, as the final boss, looked down on everything.

On November 16th, ZT Online announced its closed beta, reaching 30,000 concurrent users within three hours. As it was still in the closed beta phase and the game features were incomplete, only three server groups with a capacity of 30,000 players were opened.

On November 25th, Fantasy Westward Journey held an event to attract players, and announced that concurrent users had reached 1 million that day!

Yu Manli walked out holding Ming Fan's arm and carrying a suitcase. Ming Fan didn't quite dare to look Yu Manli in the eye, trying his best to straighten his back, but unfortunately, they ran into Wang Fei at the door and couldn't avoid trouble in the end.

Walking out of the old mansion, Ye Zhen waved down a taxi. "Shifu, I just arrived today. Are there any fun places nearby? Just take us there directly, not too far." Ye Zhen saw that it was getting late; just a casual break would be fine.

Ning Jia's brother and I quickly introduced ourselves, and then, under Chen Jing's arrangement, we sat down in front of the computers one by one.

But in the end, she, who was so kind, picked up a gun herself and walked down a path she once loathed.

Afterward, the two went to the cafeteria for a bite to eat. There was a party hosted by an instructor in the evening that Jiang Ningning also wanted to attend. "Beep, beep." Just then, Ye Zhen's phone rang.

I had never thought about this question and was stunned by Nangong Qianlan's inquiry. In fact, Old Chen would surely have thought of a way, but since he didn't say it, it must be very difficult.

It was fine to become a celebrity and make headlines, but it had to be for things Ye Zhen had actually done. Ye Zhen didn't want to fake anything. Charitable work was fine, but if the charity was also ineffective, Ye Zhen didn't want the media fabricating fake news to boost his popularity.

After winter began, Xiang Shan learned of this and believed the eight should be handed over to the Count of Pingdu for disposal. He reported it to the Count of Hu'an, but before Meng Long went to Yushui, he had already hidden the eight people somewhere unknown. Because Meng Long then went to Zhidu, the matter was put on hold.

"Professor Chu, not done working yet? Are the students giving you a headache?" Doctor Qin asked, looking at Professor Chu who was hunched over organizing materials.

"I know, I know! Here! As you requested, I've prepared the weapons for the 15 of you!" Chi Li waved his hand with a helpless look, the ring on his finger flashed, and a black spatial portal appeared.

Su Wanqing was also looking at Zhang Daoqing at this moment; evidently, she too couldn't comprehend what Zhang Daoqing had just said.

This was uranium, the most common nuclear fuel. If a fission reaction occurred on the spot, the entire Liancheng City would likely be blasted into a scorched hellscape.

The sudden pull made him lose his balance. He staggered two steps and bumped into a solid "wall," nearly falling flat on his back.

Zhang Daoqing snorted coldly. This Celestial Master was quite something, even bringing a team of bodyguards. He had completely forgotten the ascetic rules of the Daoist sect.

Ruan Jiaojiao rolled her eyes. She had been carrying the remaining half-bag of fertilizer in her hand the whole time, just in case any unforeseen situation occurred.

Seeing the newcomer's face clearly, Xiao Tong's gaze immediately sharpened, because this person was none other than the Eastern Palace Attendant Chamberlain, Zhao Feng.

The guards on both sides and the crowd below the stage were dumbfounded. How was this possible! The Fifth Elder's Yin Wind Palm strength was completely ineffective.

Watching Xiao Tong's departing figure, a smile of a successful scheme finally appeared on Emperor Liang's face.

She recognized that deep, yet bright azure blue, like the sea. Not only on her younger brother, but also from the kind and handsome face in her childhood memories. Those eyes had always gazed at her with focus and gentleness.

Just when the proletarian revolutionary situation was looking excellent, the Central Imperialists couldn't wait to jump out. They gave both men and guns to the White Russian reactionaries, which fully demonstrates that the nature of imperialism's desire to destroy the red regime has never changed.
